packageRules.description: Deckhand's own images (latest, or the release's tag) and the end-to-end check's fakes are built here, not updated.

Node's image, every Dockerfile in one pull request (setup-node and CI's node:26 container follow the major, below). Node 26 is a decision (AGENTS.md, checks.yml's node-version, esbuild's --target=node26), never a major bump of its own. The node:26-* tags float, so Node's patches come with each build, not from Renovate.
setup-node's node-version follows the major, as the node:26-* tags do: not pinned.
Valkey's and BuildKit's images: the kustomize component and the Helm values in the same pull request, as test/helm-chart.test.mjs holds them equal.
The dashboard's minor and patch updates in one pull request; each major in its own.
The docs site's, the same way.

prBodyNotes: graphql-js parses the runs' GraphQL in the GitHub gateway: check `listener/vendor/graphql.entry.mjs`'s imports still exist, and that the tests pass against the pinned `github.graphql`.

packageRules.description: The actions only: the workflows' service and container images (CI's Redis) come as their own pull requests.
Binaries pinned by version and sha256: Renovate's hosted app can't compute the sums, so CI fails until someone updates them.

prBodyNotes: **needs-sha**: update the `amd64` and `arm64` sums in `policy-service/Dockerfile` from the release's `opa_linux_<arch>_static.sha256` (CI's tests read them from there too). A new version may bring builtins that read files or the network: check them against `policy-service/engine.mjs`'s `REMOVED`.
**needs-sha**: update the `amd64` and `arm64` sums in `runner/Dockerfile`, of the release's `buildkit-v<version>.linux-<arch>.tar.gz` (its digests).

**needs-sha**: update the matching `*_SHA256` in `.github/workflows/checks.yml`'s `kubernetes` job, the sha256 of the `linux-amd64` tarball its install step downloads. helm's in `.github/workflows/release-workflow.yml`'s `chart` job too, the same sum (`test/release-workflow.test.mjs`).
The sandboxes install this agent on first use. `docs/security/network.md` lists the hosts it calls, checked against one version: check the new one calls no other.
`machine/deckhand-machine.mjs`'s `CHECKED_WITH` names the Claude Code version the machine driver was checked against: decide whether this one needs checking again.
